assumptions.pitcher: NX CAD stand-in (s1_forward.geometry(0)), spout tip anchored at the measured tip
assumptions.law: ForwardLaw() defaults (C_d 0.6, C_v 1, H = max head, projected widths)
assumptions.fill: smallest V0 with Q >= 1 mL/s on >= min(98%, f(500 mL) - 1%) of the observed-on time
assumptions.observed_on: axis tilt >= running max over 1.0 s - 6.0 deg
assumptions.scale: cup radius 0.49 D <-> median disc radius; positions, velocities / L, flows / L^3
assumptions.smoothing: poses sigma 0.04 s, disc sigma 0.15 s
assumptions.closure: S1 parameters (latte_imex/data/s1_forward), Params defaults (visc symmetric, offcup account)
